desc: The action-command dojo from its start to its end: asked for 700 frames after the warp (TTYD_MODERUN_DOJO=0,0,1,1: the first dummy, attacking every turn, Goombella out first, every move lent), its practice battle fought by the auto-battler (god mode: the dummy never falls, so no god power) with each press judged, then left from the battle 4000 frames in (TTYD_MODERUN_LEAVE, Leave as the Settings tab's button does): the battle ends as run away, the dojo ends, Mario back in Rogueport; control back with nothing lent and the file's stats, partners, badges, items, key items, coins, Star Points and story exactly as before
log_must: \[moderun\] dojo asked: dummy 0, attacks 0, partner 1, every move 1
\[modes\] leave: the battle ends as run away
\[moderun\] check after Action-command dojo: stats same, partners same, badges same, items same, key items same, coins (\d+) -> \1, star points (\d+) -> \2, story same
